name: Knockout with a second chance (heats of 3, second-chance round, main-draw rounds, final)
description: Round 1 heats of about 3 (2 to 4 riders per heat): the winner of each heat goes to the main draw and everyone else rides the second-chance round. Second-chance winners join the main draw, which runs as many rounds as it needs to reach the final; every round uses the same target, minimum and maximum riders per heat. Every rider rides at least 2 heats. Optional flag-out in Round 1 at minute 8 (lowest-scoring rider out; others continue). Inspired by the Red Bull King of the Air 2026 format (18 riders); set the target to 2 for 1 v 1 heats.
basedOn: Red Bull King of the Air 2026 format (redbull.com)
